approaches_tried.approach: Independently re-run bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh (full, without --skip-slow) to double-check the deploy-headless.sh result
approaches_tried.reason: Two attempts were auto-backgrounded by the harness (Bash-tool timeout not raised past default on the first; a shell-level timeout's SIGTERM not honored by a descendant on the second), leaving orphaned process trees that contended with concurrent sibling-task test-suite activity on specs/.gate-lock (verify-deploy-gate8), stalling further invocations. Diagnosed via ps/pstree, killed the orphaned trees, and reverted to relying on the already-complete first deploy-headless.sh run's output, which is sufficient and consistent with the Batch Gate Deferral directive (gate 8 is --skip-slow-deferred by design).

deviations.reason: Landed at RESULT=landed_verify_red due to 3 pre-existing, out-of-scope fast-gate findings (eager-load budget overage, a lean-extension shellcheck finding, 2 memory-extension /ide dead-command-recommendation violations), each independently verified to predate this task's first commit. The redeploy itself landed correctly; only the verification status differs from the plan's literal expectation.
